title: tetraclea coulteri f. angustifolia
intro: Tetraclea coulteri f. angustifolia, commonly known as Coulter's twinflower, is a plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tetraclea coulteri f. angustifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, glycosides, and other organic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
